change_control.reason: Confirmed glucuronide ring false positives in statin_like_hydroxy_acid SMARTS.
change_control.scope: Only require the statin dihydroxy-acid side chain atoms to be non-ring atoms; weights and all other gates remain unchanged.

evidence_direction_change.reason: ChEMBL phospholipidosis and target-only activities were incorrectly treated as positive lipid-lowering evidence.
evidence_direction_change.scope: Split activities into positive cellular phenotype, adverse lipid phenotype, mechanism support and annotation; only explicit direction-matched cellular lipid reduction contributes to lipid evidence.

scientific_degradation_change.reason: A Quality-Max run disabled snapshots, reported no candidate evidence, admitted a borderline high-uncertainty toxicity candidate, and sorted relaxed quota candidates below lower-scoring candidates.
scientific_degradation_change.scope: Force and hash snapshot use in auto mode; report candidate-level evidence misses; gate proxy-only candidates on a conservative toxicity upper bound; distinguish engineering PASS from scientific validation; preserve final-score ordering after portfolio selection.

evidence_query_contract_change.reason: Query failures, verified empty results and ambiguous PubChem identities were not represented as distinct machine-readable outcomes.
evidence_query_contract_change.scope: Add non-scoring query status states; prevent multi-CID PubChem identity ambiguity from producing toxicity scores; bind export artifacts and evidence-bake manifests to deterministic selection hashes.

evidence_circuit_and_mechanism_context_c.reason: Circuit-open candidates were mislabeled as verified empty during evidence baking, and target context was not separated from candidate-target evidence.
evidence_circuit_and_mechanism_context_c.scope: Represent circuit-open as not_queried/query_failed; add a non-scoring candidate-target-disease-pathway graph whose candidate edges remain explicit hypotheses and whose target context uses frozen official identifiers.

scientific_claim_and_audit_change.reason: Local structural toxicity proxies were being counted as safety-clearance evidence, and candidate-level scientific claim limits were not exported.
scientific_claim_and_audit_change.scope: Keep computational proxy nomination available while setting safety evidence coverage to zero without direct evidence; add scientific_status, claim_ceiling, endpoint query status, all-candidate score JSONL and evidence ledger artifacts; exclude self/near-self kNN entries during GoldSet regression.

origene_evidence_semantics_change.reason: Evidence lineage/identity cutoff and Top-M orchestration, citations, structured selection reasons.
origene_evidence_semantics_change.scope: Add EvidenceBundle lineage fields and evidence_type vocabulary; keep annotation/query_audit out of lipid_query_status and scientific scores; ML/proxy clearance must not inflate safety_clearance_confidence; Top-M runs identity→fill→re-eligibility; export citations.jsonl and selection_audit.jsonl. Default gate thresholds unchanged (min_toxicity_confidence/min_safety_evidence_coverage remain 0.0).

screening_assumptions_alignment_change.reason: Freeze fixed 10 micromolar screening, CCK-8 as the primary viability endpoint with >80% as no obvious damage, parallel lipid/viability interpretation, relative effect and novelty ranking, equal contribution of Top10 seats, and sequential reserves.
screening_assumptions_alignment_change.scope: Freeze machine-readable screening assumptions; add run-relative percentile effect and novelty proxies with product primary and equal-mean sensitivity view; retain toxicity as eligibility/risk evidence; export Top10 plus an ordered reserve CSV and bind both selections into the run manifest.

epa_stage2_activation_change.reason: The full EPA CTX bioactivity summary completed with 17,169 DTXSIDs, zero network errors, and a hash-matched imported manifest.
epa_stage2_activation_change.scope: Make EPA stage 2 the recommended default. Score only nhit>0 with cytotoxLowerUm at or below 10 uM; share that cytotox ceiling across identical standardized SMILES; keep activeMc/activeSc and CAS-only identity uncertainty as non-gating audit/annotation.

nomination_review_reproducibility_change.reason: Manual shortlist review (e.g. withdrawn zomepirac) must survive clean re-runs of the same repository.
nomination_review_reproducibility_change.scope: Add hashed clinical_exclusions.yaml hard gates and nomination_review.yaml seat/annotation decisions; export algorithmic and nominated Top10 plus dual selection hashes in the run manifest.
